provenance.reference: TUNING_V0 Movement & defense; inclusive iframe ranges normalized to half-open windows
provenance.authoredReason: Round-1 chair adjudication G4 moved the heavy Burden band from 11 i-frames (t2–t12) to 13 (t2–t14) so the GATES F5 ±6 guarantee holds against the eight-tick contact windows (wolf lunge, lantern-fire arc). Total ticks, actionableFromTick 36, and attackCancelFromTick 26 are unchanged, so the band keeps the worst recovery.

Round-1 chair adjudication G2 raised the light attack cost 14 to 20: at 14 a full bar bought seven consecutive lights, which read as free. Twenty gives the five casts from full that GATES F7 now names. Every other cost is TUNING_V0 verbatim.
TUNING_V0 supplies each base/stagger value but says only that flinch/stagger/knockdown use a class table; flinch at half-base and knockdown at twice-base are explicit v0 authored thresholds.

provenance.reference: TUNING_V0 Breath guard cost/guard break; hearth-iron critical commitment; S11 defense contract

Round-1 finding G3 added criticalReachMeters: TUNING_V0 names no engage distance for the critical rows, so 1.5 m (two capsule radii plus a hearth-iron step-in) is the explicit v0 authored bound that stops a rear-cone attack press from opening a backstab across the arena.
